title: Ecru sets Thursday afternoon deadline for utility payments
excerpt: The Town of Ecru says utility bills must be paid before 5 p.m. Nov. 19. Its reminder includes an online payment option.
locality: Town of Ecru, Pontotoc County, Mississippi.

sources.title: Town of Ecru’s November 17 utility payment reminder

facts.statement: Ecru utility bills must be paid before 5 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 19, the town told customers in a payment reminder Tuesday.
facts.evidence: The November 17 town notice explicitly says payment before 5:00 pm Thursday November 19 and links the EZPay portal.
facts.date_context: Town notice on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, sets a local Thursday, November 19, 2026 deadline.
facts.locality: Town of Ecru, Pontotoc County, Mississippi.
facts.identities: Town of Ecru, Mississippi; Mississippi EZPay; Mississippi Municipal League.

facts.statement: For online payment, the town directs customers to Mississippi EZPay. Choose the utility bill option and select Town of Ecru from the list of providers. Residents with questions for the town can call 662-489-3881, the number listed in the Mississippi Municipal League’s directory.
facts.evidence: Town notice links msezpay.com. Its provider list includes Town of Ecru. The Municipal League directory lists the town phone as (662) 489-3881.

paragraphs.text: Ecru utility bills must be paid before 5 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 19, the town told customers in a payment reminder Tuesday.

For online payment, the town directs customers to Mississippi EZPay. Choose the utility bill option and select Town of Ecru from the list of providers. Residents with questions for the town can call 662-489-3881, the number listed in the Mississippi Municipal League’s directory.
